notes.content:
[p align="start"]Hey everyone!
Time for the update you’ve all been waiting for – progress news and the release date for Episode 5.0![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/79f89f488627ffe7bf4ee511b1072913f33cb6f8.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]We’re almost there: only two more scenes left to finish on the art side, and we’re rendering the final animations. Scenes are already being added and coded into the game. Next week we’ll begin translations. On top of that, there will be new achievements, bonus content, wallpapers, and a small UI upgrade. The replay system will also get better – you’ll be able to see how to unlock them and easily check what content you might have missed.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]And now, the dates you’ve been waiting for - Episode 5.0 will be available for:[/p][list][*][p][b]Devoted+ tiers[/b] – November 5 (evening CET)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inquisitive+ tiers + Steam & Itch[/b] – November 8 (evening CET)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Attentive tier[/b] – November 15 (evening CET)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We know this update took longer than usual. It’s a normal-sized release (bigger than previous ones, around 10 scenes and 60–90 minutes of gameplay, but won't call it big). But don’t worry – a big DLC is coming just a month later, with more details in early October. And yes, we’ve got a few more surprises planned too![/p][p align="start"]One more piece of news: [i]Exploring the Big Apple[/i] – a game by SadPepper, published by us – will be available on [b]Steam, October 17[/b]! It comes with a fresh UI, translations, sounds, and more. If you haven’t already, make sure to add it to your wishlist.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720820/Exploring_the_Big_Apple/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]And finally – here are some fresh renders from the update.
See you soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/12a8cdbdc81edd16ac8b435b71765005df352256.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/ae9d8d87854111cdac1edfa63580c183b6b5a280.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/7167e3aae7faadf08c791e4137f51643cd5b408c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/64168383374eb696cdbd044dada717aa75c71bf1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Episode 5.0 – Developer Logs & Progress
notes.content:
[p]Hi friends!
It’s been a while, and we’ve made some new renders, so here’s a little update on how things are going. Everything is on track – see you again next month, hehe.[/p][p][/p][p]But seriously, let’s start with a progress update:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/c80878dea55eebc630fa972908e0e72cf4e73373.png"][/img][/p][p]The scripts are written, the text part is 100% done, coding and testing are going smoothly, and the graphics - the most time-consuming part – are about halfway finished. As I mentioned before, we’re not only working on Episode 5.0, but also on a new DLC that will be released later this year.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s still a bit too early to share details about the DLC – what it’s about, how far we are, or when exactly it’s coming – but you’ll find out soon. I often get questions about why we’re focusing on DLC when the main game isn’t finished yet. The answer is simple: it’s not about “grabbing money” (though extra funds always help), but about wanting to work on something fresh. After spending so much time on [i]Steps of Debauchery[/i] and Riley’s main story, I started feeling a bit burned out. I almost took a long break, but instead I decided to work on a different Riley story. This DLC is fun, lighthearted, and very naughty – making it has been a joy for me, and I think you’ll enjoy it just as much. So no more burnout – I’m more motivated than ever.[/p][p][/p][p]Back to Episode 5.0 – it could be ready earlier than November, but since we’re focusing on the DLC now, we want to keep everything stress-free and smooth. So the official release date for Episode 5.0 is early November (exact day to be announced next month). If things go well, we’ll move straight to creating Episode 5.1, which should make the next updates come out faster.[/p][p][/p][p]Honestly, I’ve looked at the new renders so much that I sometimes feel like the episode is already released – but nope, it’s just the upcoming update :D
Before I go, please add [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720820/Exploring_the_Big_Apple/"]Exploring the Big Apple[/url] to your wishlist – it’s coming next month![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720820/Exploring_the_Big_Apple/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And instead of the usual teasers, I’ve got a little game for you: here are 4 renders of Riley’s butt. One is from the new DLC, one is bonus content, and two are from the upcoming update. Can you guess which is which? Let me know in the comments![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/42d6e875ff1848a2b7cc8e9813a0e814884afa86.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/51cbedc1dc456286311a1705b09c169f79152abf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/8a7765ee2e322fe8172e541a6589a05b2f5df179.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/236e80bdf5cff947e4c6b9ddd48ab0616abd5312.png"][/img][i]Ain't that a great view?[/i][/p]

notes.title: Episode 5.0 - current progress
notes.content: [p][b]Hey there![/b][/p][p]It's been a few days, so it's the perfect time to share a quick update on what we've been working on. As usual, let's start with some visuals:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/c464e90730f60d87480b5293f14052c806794ab1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As you can see, the scripts, meaning the written content, dialogues, and all that, are almost done. All scenes are already planned out. We might still add a few extra things like achievements, but overall, this part should be fully finished by next week.[/p][p][/p][p]On the programming and testing side, we’ve added a few new features and, more importantly, fixed all previously reported bugs. Some of you have issues launching the game on Steam, that’s because of a recent Ren’Py update (which is the engine most AVNs are made with). Luckily, there’s already a solution posted on the forum, so check it out if you're having problems![/p][p][/p][p]Now, for the biggest and most time-consuming part: renders. We’ve completed about 30% of the upcoming update, which will likely have the most animations we've ever done. At the same time, we're also working on the previously mentioned DLC, which should also come out this year. Things are going smoothly now. We’ve already created the biggest and most difficult scenes, so everything should move even faster from here.[/p][p][/p][p]Writing this made me realize how much we’ve actually accomplished - especially considering it’s only been a month since the last update! I’m not ready to give a release date for Episode 5.0 just yet /anything can happen/ but we’re aiming for October. Maybe sooner, maybe later. It’s still too early to say for sure. What I can say is that you’ll definitely enjoy what we have in store for you this year.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now! If you haven’t already, please consider leaving a review on Steam and adding [i]Exploring the Big Apple[/i] to your wishlist (you can find info about it in the last devlog).[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720820/Exploring_the_Big_Apple/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]I’m leaving a few renders as always - talk to you soon and have a great weekend![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/742f4fa2821efaaf6088621cc4979ae793f6e816.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/059a75c862349172ad2d00f4f9946a3d9441ca38.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/678aba5133d75b5a055d03116c76d0a3a8b15adb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/398b00b31a1670f9058c05208317ddc2d728ec94.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/01484747e458363010c24c32d0a49281e32f5259.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Project Progress and Upcoming Surprises
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey there![/b][/p][p]
We've had a pretty busy time lately, and I'm really happy with how things are going. I also have some updates for you from different angles – but let’s start with [i]Steps of Debauchery[/i].[/p][p]We decided to expand the main story a bit with a new side plot and add more depth to some of the existing scenes. This means the game will be bigger – but in a good way! You’ll get more of Riley, without unnecessary filler. And don’t worry – all of this will be part of the base game. If you’re already supporting us or bought the game on Steam, you’ll get everything included.[/p][p]New scenes are coming along smoothly, and I’m really happy with our progress. They’re much larger than before – for example, early scenes had around 70–100 renders, but now some go over 300 renders and include lots of animations. So yes, they take longer to make, but they feel much more immersive and natural.[/p][p][/p][p]At the same time, we’re working on a cool DLC. It’s not just a short bonus – it will be a fully developed story. I can’t tell you when it’s coming or what it will include (it’s a surprise!), but trust me, it’s something special. Just thinking about it puts a smile on my face.[/p][p][/p][p]Last thing – we’re supporting a new project as a [b]publisher[/b]! It’s a game called [i]Exploring the Big Apple[/i] by SadPepper, where you’ll play as Emma, the main character. If you like [i]Steps of Debauchery[/i], you’ll probably enjoy this one too![/p][p]We helped with proofreading, translations into 7 languages, a new UI, achievements, and some extra features to improve the game. Like with [i]Bright Lord[/i], the original animations, renders, and story all stay true to the creator’s vision. Also, all the extra work was done by people we specifically hired for that project – so it hasn’t slowed down the development of [i]SoD[/i] in any way.[/p][p]The game is already visible on Steam and will be available for purchase in early Q4 2025. Feel free to add it to your wishlist now – it’ll be worth it![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720820/Exploring_the_Big_Apple/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/c75852e221ad4b914575bc775536ea3ca2676a38.jpg"][/img][/p][p]That’s all for today’s update. I’m heading back to work on Episode 5.0 – which is already shaping up to be one of my favorites :)[/p]

notes.title: Not for Everyone – And That’s Okay
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]It’s been a few days since the 4.2 update, the excitement has settled down, so it’s time for a quick summary.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, some people say the update was too small, so let me remind you: we’re using all the time and resources we have to make updates as fast as possible. We're also looking for new artists to speed things up, but so far we haven’t found anyone who meets our quality standards. We won’t lower the quality of the game just to release updates faster.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, everything is going according to plan – actually even better. We’re adding new scenes that we didn’t originally plan, and they’re not slowing us down.[/p][p][/p][p]As I said last year – and I’ll say it again – the final update (version 7.0 or 8.0) will come in the second half of 2026 and it will be the end of the game. If you bought the game on Steam, you’ll get that update for free. We’re not going to ask you to pay for extra chapters/acts or anything like that (we plan side-story DLCs though!).[/p][p][/p][p]Now, about the content. Some scenes might feel like you have no control over the story – but that’s not true. Most scenes now have different dialogue and renders depending on the choices you made earlier. This will become even more noticeable in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]And yes – most sex scenes are and will remain non-skippable. That’s part of the game’s genre: “Debauchery” and “Corruption.” We’re planning 4 different endings – but none of them include Riley becoming a nun. We know not everyone likes this style or genre, and that’s okay. Some people don’t like female protagonists, some don’t like sandbox games, and some don’t like how we tell the story. But many of you do – and that’s why we’ll keep going.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, some haters appeared on Steam and other forums. So let me say it again – this game isn’t for everyone. It’s actually funny how some people come back with every update just to say how bad the game is... and still play it. That’s the definition of hypocrisy.[/p][p][/p][p]Back to the production – Episode 5.0 will definitely come out this year, but we’re not ready to share a release date yet because… we’re also preparing a surprise for you later this year.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re now entering the second half of the year and the whole Steps of Debauchery team is hard at work. Episode 5.0 has been in development even before 4.2 was released, and it will move the story forward much faster and include a lot of new content. I won’t call it “huge” – some people expect 5 hours of new content every month, which is just not possible without hurting quality – but we’re doing our best and using all our free time to work on it.[/p][p][/p][p]There’s also another surprise we haven’t mentioned yet – I’ll tell you more about that next week.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s it from me for now. To sum up – this game isn’t for everyone. If you haven’t liked it so far, it’s probably not the game for you. Trying to change my mind won’t help. To everyone else – thank you so much for your support, kind words, and financial help. [b]We wouldn’t be here without you.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Take care and enjoy your Sunday![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/f66b4defc53dd80a71abe1a733de2f424d320a7c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/45f014734ece46d0d3cc8aae7bc9b20b1135d66b.png"][/img][/p]

[b]Hi everyone![/b] I thought Friday would be a great day to share a few words and some preview renders.

Honestly, I’m really happy with what we’ve created so far. This update has also been moving along quite fast – we’ve finished all the scripts (the writer is already working on episode 5.0). We’ve completed 4 scenes and we’re working on more scenes and animations now.

That’s the good news. The not-so-good news is that things will slow down a bit for the next few weeks. Not because of any problems, but because I need to spend more time at my firefighter job for the next 3 weeks.

And on top of that… I’m getting married to my lovely blonde fiancée on May 31! So I won’t have much time to make new renders for a while.

Other artists are still trying to get into the rhythm of the team, but right now they only manage around 30–40 renders a month, which isn’t much help. Still, I hope things will improve every week.

I can’t give you a release date for update 4.2 yet, but it will definitely come after my wedding. The second half of the year should be much better for making updates.

And trust me—update 5.0 will be a banger, and things will only get better after that! That should be it, thank you for your trust and patience, it will be worth to wait.

notes.title: Episode Summary
notes.content:
Hey!

It's been a few days since the update, so it's time for a few words from me and a little summary. As always, the feedback has been mixed—some people say things like "small update," "we waited so long for this," "where are the sex scenes?" or "this update brought nothing new."

Over the years of working on Visual Novels, I’ve learned one thing—people will always complain, and it will never be enough, no matter how much time, effort, and energy go into making them happy. Even a small update takes weeks or months of constant work—writing scripts, rendering, animating, coding, fixing issues—it’s not a quick process. And hiring artists who can maintain the required quality isn't an option, which is why it takes time. Every month, we put more hours into this project than we actually have, often at the cost of our personal lives.

...but I’m getting carried away—that’s not what this post was supposed to be about. Most of you expect an update to be packed with sex scenes, which makes sense since this is an adult game. But many people don’t understand the importance of writing, building tension, structuring the story, and weaving different plotlines together. SoD has a lot of fans (and just as many haters) precisely because we take this approach. Everything is planned—we know where we’re going and won’t change direction just because someone expected something different from this update.

As I’ve said many times, Early Access is about supporting the developer. If you’re going to complain after every update that it was smaller than expected, maybe just wait a year and a half for the full release—then you can judge whether it was worth it or just trash.

I tend to focus too much on negative comments, which is one of my flaws, but I also want to thank those who leave positive feedback. The people who understand that even non-animated scenes that aren’t in the replay gallery still matter because they connect to future scenes and upcoming updates.

That’s all I wanted to say—Adult Visual Novel means both "Adult" and "Novel." If you're only here for one part, you’re going to be disappointed.

Anyway, have a great day!

notes.title: Post-Release Thoughts and Plans
notes.content:
A few days have passed since the release, so now with a clear head, it’s time for a quick recap of the last update of the year, plans for the coming weeks, and a look at what’s ahead for next year. Hi there!

Let’s start with the latest update. Overall, I’m pretty happy with it. From what I’ve read, most of you received it quite positively, except the usual complaints about "so short", "add my favorite path", "such a long wait for nothing". I’ve responded to these points after every update, but I’ll do it again here. Update 4.0 took me two months to make, working 14–16 hours a day, including weekends, and giving up social outings and personal enjoyments like the Stalker and PoE2 releases I’d been looking forward to (still haven’t played them). Comments like these make me a bit sad because I put so much of myself into this, but the reaction are always the same, no matter how hard I try. As for paths like Richard’s, not every path gets touched in every update - you’ll sometimes need to wait longer. So, if small updates aren’t your thing, it might be better to wait for 3–4 updates to drop or just hold out for the full release in 2026.

That said, I don’t want to sound bitter. I’m still happy with where we are now. Over the past 14 months since the game’s release, I think we’ve made huge progress. The renders are at a solid quality level, and the animations have significantly improved, so our focus now is on maintaining this standard.

The latest update also marks a turning point many of you were waiting for, but I also want to mention that there are not going to be a lot of branching paths - for example, the LI choice in the park quest had some importance but wasn’t crucial enough to warrant separate saves. You’ll see more in the next update. For now, we’re planning 4 main endings with some smaller variations.

Before moving on, I want to say thank you. When I launched the game in October 2023, I never imagined it would become my hobby, passion, and main source of income. This wouldn’t have been possible without your support. Thanks to you, I can create this game and not worry about tomorrow. Starting in January, I’ll be returning to my main job as a firefighter, but I’ll still dedicate all my free time to the game to keep updates coming every 2–3 months. And yes, they’ll be the same size as the current ones. I prefer to make smaller updates, but more often.

In three days, I’m taking my first proper break in a long time. I can’t remember a single day in the past 14 months when I wasn’t working on the game or at least thinking about what to add or improve. These two weeks should help me recharge so I can come back ready to continue Riley’s story.

As I mentioned, the full version of Steps of Debauchery is planned for 2026. We don’t want to stretch this project endlessly, and we already have a clear vision of what we want to deliver. The next update will likely come in March. Updates 4.1 and 4.2 will be smaller, as usual, focusing on side stories, slight progress in the main plot, and expanding additional features like jobs and free roam. We’ll also add some optional elements that we hope you’ll enjoy. I won’t spoil everything, though as that would ruin the fun! :)

Lot of reading, huh? So here’s the conclusion: Updates will stay small because we simply don’t have the resources (i.e., 3D artists) to create more scenes faster. Quality will always come before quantity. I’ve scheduled a few posts for you while I’m away so you don’t forget about me.

Luckily, I didn’t suffer any major damage—just a few things to replace, lots of cleaning and drying out, but thankfully, my family is safe. Today we’re finally getting back to normal, with electricity and water restored (though it’s only cold water for now, but it’s progress!). I’ve been wondering why it now takes me 1.5-2 months to make a small update, when I used to be able to do it in just one month. The answer is pretty simple – translations take a lot of time, and the animations are much more time-consuming (but they also look way better) compared to the early days. We still keep the same number of quests in each small update, around 7, but before, the scenes were much smaller – each had 70-100 renders, and now each scene has over 100, with some having more than 200.

notes.title: Episode 3.1 - Update Summary, Game Development and Notes
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey everyone![/h1][/b]

I have a lot to share with you today, but let's start with a summary of the latest update and some of my notes. I've already shared these on Discord, but I'll summarize them here too.

The days after releasing a new update are always the toughest for me mentally. I spend them combing through every forum reading players feedback. This includes everything from trolls and long-time critics to supportive fans. I’m also on the lookout for bugs reported by players so we can fix them promptly. 

[h2]Bugs and Issues[/h2] 
We've fixed all the reported bugs. One critical bug related to the iSpy app was preventing further progress in some cases. There were also minor issues with minigames, Discord on Mac, and a missing scene in the replay gallery. These have all been fixed. We've also made the dance minigame a bit easier and we’re ready to fix any new bugs immediately.

[h2]Feedback on Update Length[/h2] 
I've addressed this many times, but here’s my previous information about the developing job (I wrote it some time ago, so that's copy-paste):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/b3cddb803b21ad4f3b28adf359e9870d664d1b34.jpg[/img]
...my job as a firefighter sometimes allows me extra time off, which I dedicate to game development. Over the past three months (aside from my vacation), I’ve been working 12-16 hours daily to create what we’ve released. Despite this, some still find the update “short.” I might need to slow down and give myself more mental freedom because no matter how hard I work, people will always complain about the update being too short. (edit. we are actively looking for additional Daz3D artists, but we rather want to improve the quality of the renders, so finding the right person(s) is very hard and we have not succeeded so far).

[h2]Content and Story Feedback[/h2] 
I agree that we could have added more sexual content to the yacht scene, but I didn't think it was appropriate and really needed. We don't want to add empty sex scenes just for the sake of it. This update was not shallow in my opinion, as it containted three other sex scenes. I'm sure we'll soon get to the point where everyone will see what they're waiting for, but scenes in which sexual acts don't occur also affect the main character's mental attitude. You may disagree with this, but it does not change my approach to the storyline we are creating.

It’s important to remember that an Adult Visual Novel combines both - "Adult" content, but also "Novel" aspect. If someone is here only for the adult content and ignores the novel aspect, they might be disappointed—that’s not our aim (yes, I'm aware we are creating porn game :wink:)

Regarding complaints about the D&D, Elijah or any other plotlines: it's impossible to please everyone. Some enjoy these storylines, others don’t. Making them optional would undermine the main narrative. Every plot point, including D&D, has an impact on the main character, if not now, then in future updates. We don't add random storylines; everything has a purpose. We also can't feature every character in every update. Episode 2.2 focused on Elijah and Richard; 3.0 focused on other things; episode 3.1 will be about something else. We’re doing our best to release content quickly and on time. If you found this update small, you might want to wait for 4.0 and skip previous two small updates till then.

Lastly, regarding the bar minigame: it’s optional and doesn’t affect the main story, but we already made it easier for everyone. It will have its development in episode 3.1 but will remain non-essential to the main plot.

That would be it. I take every feedback to heart, we have our idea for the game, but we also take your opinion into consideration. However, we will not add a sex scene with Riley, just because we feel such pressure on our backs. I am always available to you and I write back to every message, however, if you need help with the game or you have encountered an error - share it on discord so that it is easier to solve them. If you would like to add something, feel free to comment and share your thoughts.

[h1]That will be it about Episode 3.0, so let's move to development of Episode 3.1 and some notes![/h1]

[b]Progress on Episode 3.1 is going smoothly.[/b] As you can see in the image below, our scripts and writing are almost done. We've also completed about 40% of the graphics and renders, and started adding new scenes and content directly to the game. We're planning to add six main scenes, one extra scene, and more activities related to the park, school, and the bar minigame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/fd5920b99469e400dc9e55816029483f59e96015.png[/img]

[b]Episode 3.1 will be a small update.[/b] We're sticking to our plan of releasing two small updates (x.1 and x.2) followed by a bigger one (0.x). [b]If you don't like small updates, please wait for the next one or even Episode 4.0.[/b] Respect our work and refrain from comments like "too short." We're doing our best to release updates regularly and spend all our free time creating the game. The new update will be out in mid-August.

(Who would I be if I didn't share a few new renders?)

Take care and see you soon!

notes.title: After Release Reflections
notes.content:
Hi there!

It's been exactly a week since the game was released on Steam, so it's time for a little summary. The game has attracted a lot of interest, beyond our expectations, which delights us immensely and gives us the momentum to create new updates and scenes. Thank you!

We've received various opinions and private messages - some opinions were certainly helpful as they provided additional perspectives on the entire project, while others were strictly about the content itself or other games. First and foremost, I'd like to mention that a year ago, I knew nothing about being a developer or releasing games; my focus was mainly on creating renders. I've learned a lot during this time, but I realize there's still much to learn, and even more to improve. However, believe me, I'm learning quickly, and I'll quickly catch up - and as Bill Brooks wrote, you don't need super knowledge, just surround yourself with the right people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/0df6704aad252ca920cefcf9ff2a577651d5b898.png[/img]

Regarding the content and its quantity - as I've mentioned several times before, a game based on the corruption of the main character needs to be a bit of a slow burn to show their transformation. If it happens too quickly, the whole story wouldn't make sense. We're roughly at 25-30% completion of the entire project, so there are still many scenes ahead of you (and us).

However, comparing our project to others like "Innocence and Money," "Being a DIK," etc., and giving negative ratings based on them is somewhat unfair from one simple standpoint - they've been in development for years and often by experienced developers, whereas our project is still in its infancy and only growing, so please give it time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/5b49d68ff9bea78dc6e5c8fe83f7df86bb6fb79f.png[/img]

That's it for now; I hope you all enjoyed it nonetheless, and thank you for your trust. We won't let you down! As you could read in Early Access, the entire project is planned for 7-8 episodes (more likely 7, but we'll see if we want to add additional side plots and expand the world more than planned), with each episode having two smaller chapters. Below, I present you with the update schedule:

Episode 1.0 -> 1.1 -> 1.2 

Episode 2.0 -> 2.1 -> 2.2  (we are here and working on update 2.2)

Episode 3.0 -> 3.1 -> 3.2 

Episode 4.0 -> 4.1 -> 4.2 

Episode 5.0 -> 5.1 -> 5.2 

Episode 6.0 -> 6.1 -> 6.2 

Episode 7

We plan to release larger full episodes (2.0, 3.0, etc.) every approximately 8-10 weeks (9-11 scenes), followed by two smaller ones (2.1, 2.2, etc.) every approximately 5-7 weeks (5-7 scenes). I believe it's better to release smaller updates in shorter intervals than, like most developers, a big update every six months or more. We truly value quality, and each of us works in every spare moment to achieve the goal.

That's all from me for now; I wanted you to know what our plans are and how everything looks from my perspective. I'm getting back to work because, as you know, the new update is coming in a month - March 14th!
